title: Topic 14 · 整合信息论 — 神经科学

questions.question: 一台有上百万像素的相机，按整合信息论（IIT）为什么 Φ 几乎为零？
options: 相机不会说话也不会报告，没有任何行为可以表明它有体验
像素数量远少于人脑的神经元数量，还没有达到产生意识的门槛
像素各测各的光、互不影响，传感器剪成两半也不损失任何因果结构
相机只是记录光线而不处理信息，所以根本谈不上计算与整合
questions.explanation: Φ 量的是系统作为整体的因果力比切开后各自单干多出多少。相机像素是互不搭理的小孤岛，剪成两半照样成像、毫无损失，没有「合起来才存在」的东西。IIT 明确说意识与会不会说话、聪不聪明无关，也不看零件数量。
questions.question_en: Under integrated information theory (IIT), why is a camera with millions of pixels at nearly zero Φ?
options_en: A camera can't speak or report, so there's no behavior suggesting it has experience
It has far fewer pixels than the brain has neurons, so it hasn't crossed the threshold for consciousness
Each pixel measures light independently, so cutting the sensor in half loses no causal structure
A camera only records light without processing information, so there's nothing to integrate
questions.explanation_en: Φ measures how much causal power a system has as a whole beyond its parts cut apart. Camera pixels are isolated islands; snip the sensor in two and both halves still image with nothing lost. IIT says consciousness has nothing to do with speech, intelligence or part count.

questions.question: 小脑装着全脑约八成的神经元，整个受损后人却照样清醒。IIT 怎样解释这一点？
options: 小脑大部分时间处于静息状态，活跃度太低，才没能对意识做出贡献
小脑只负责运动协调，按功能分工它本来就不属于产生意识的那套系统
小脑接线像一排排各走各的传送带，很少回绕成不可分的整体，所以 Φ 低
小脑的神经元个头太小、放电又太弱，单个神经元能贡献的意识远远不如皮层
questions.explanation: IIT 的结论是神经元多不等于意识多，要数的是「拧成一团」的程度。小脑接线近乎并行、很少横向回绕，Φ 低；撑起意识的是高度回绕交织的后部皮层热区。IIT 看的是因果结构，不是功能分工或活跃度。
questions.question_en: The cerebellum holds about 80% of the brain's neurons, yet people stay conscious after losing it. How does IIT explain this?
options_en: It sits idle most of the time, and its activity is too low to contribute to consciousness
It only handles motor coordination, so by division of labor it was never part of the conscious system
Its wiring runs like parallel conveyor belts with little feedback into an irreducible whole, so its Φ is low
Its neurons are too small and fire too weakly, so each contributes far less consciousness than cortex
questions.explanation_en: IIT says more neurons doesn't mean more consciousness; what counts is how tightly things knot together. The cerebellum is wired nearly in parallel with little lateral feedback, so its Φ is low; the densely recurrent posterior hot zone carries consciousness. IIT looks at causal structure, not function or activity level.

questions.question: 一个大语言模型能写诗、推理、通过各种行为测试。按 IIT，它有没有内在体验取决于什么？
options: 它能否把信息广播给各个模块、跨模块调用，像全局工作空间那样
它在行为测试里能否骗过人类，骗得过就应当认为它有意识
它的参数规模是否超过人脑的连接数，规模够大就会涌现体验
它的物理硬件怎么接线：跑在前馈流水线上，Φ 低到可以忽略
questions.explanation: IIT 算的是物理基质本身怎么接线，不是它在算什么：同一个函数，交织的机器和流水线机器 Φ 可以天差地别。今天的芯片逐个门电路往前推，按 IIT 硬件层 Φ 可忽略。能广播就有意识是功能主义的立场，正是 IIT 的对立面。
questions.question_en: A large language model writes poetry, reasons and passes behavioral tests. Under IIT, what determines whether it has inner experience?
options_en: Whether it broadcasts information across modules for global use, like a global workspace
Whether it can fool humans in behavioral tests; if it can, we should credit it with consciousness
Whether its parameter count exceeds the brain's connections, at which point experience emerges
How its physical hardware is wired: running on a feedforward pipeline, its Φ is negligible
questions.explanation_en: IIT measures how the physical substrate is wired, not what it computes: the same function can have wildly different Φ on an interwoven machine versus a pipeline. Today's chips push signals forward gate by gate, so by IIT their hardware Φ is negligible. 'Broadcasting is enough' is functionalism, IIT's direct opponent.
